Start at https://www.google.com and complete the following task.

I’m helping the same couple plan two separate weddings and I want something I can actually review in the browser afterward. First, use Google to find official venue pages for Napa Valley wedding venues that could realistically handle about 200 guests for a fall wedding, and please open each serious option in its own tab so I can compare them side by side later. I need about 10 Napa venues, and for each one please verify from the actual venue site the venue name, where it is in the Napa Valley area, the stated maximum wedding capacity or closest guest-count language you can find, plus a short description of what kind of place it is. Once you’ve verified those, go to CryptPad Sheets and create a spreadsheet called Napa Wedding Venues with columns for venue name, location, maximum guest capacity, venue description, and link to venue page, then fill it in with the Napa venues you confirmed, making sure the rows match the tabs you’ve kept open. After that, switch to Seoul and use Google to find wedding venues or wedding halls specifically in Gangnam-gu, opening each official site or the most authoritative live venue page you can find in its own tab so I can visually review the listings. I’d like around 10 Gangnam options too, and for each one please confirm the Gangnam location, the wedding capacity or at least an approximate size if that’s all the page gives, and what type of venue it is, like hotel, wedding hall, banquet hall, or something similar. Keep those Gangnam tabs open as well, and then give me a short comparison report that summarizes the 10 Seoul options by name, location, approximate size or capacity, and venue type, because I’m trying to see how the Napa and Gangnam venue pools compare before we narrow anything down.

Rules:
- You may use search engines and open new tabs. When the task asks you to leave a page open, keep it open in its own tab and say in your final answer which page is in which tab.
- Do NOT use cached/archived copies of pages (e.g. web.archive.org); work from the live sites.
- If a site you need is blocked (bot check, login wall, error), first try to get through it — complete a bot check yourself, retry, or use another route to the same page. If it still cannot be reached, say so explicitly in your answer and do not fill in from memory what you could not read on the page.
- When the task is complete, give your final answer as plain text in your last message.

NAPA VALLEY ROMANCE

Luxury Napa Valley Weddings at Carneros Resort and Spa

Carneros Resort and Spa is the premier luxury wedding venue in California, located in the heart of Napa Valley. With nine indoor and outdoor event spaces accommodating celebrations from two to 300 guests, the resort hosts everything from grand destination weddings to intimate elopements in one of Northern California's most celebrated wine country settings. Whether you’re planning a grand affair or an intimate gathering, our team ensures a flawless experience from start to finish. To begin preparing, contact us at 707‑299‑4900 or info@carnerosresort.com.

START PLANNING

OPTIONS FOR ALL SIZES
Stunning Indoor & Outdoor Venues

Carneros Resort features over 35,000 square feet of flexible event space across nine distinctive venues. Outdoor favorites, such as The Arbor and Vineyard Lawn, offer breathtaking views of Napa Valley, while indoor spaces, including the Hilltop Dining Room and Napa Ballroom, bring modern elegance. From curated catering to detailed planning, each wedding is tailored to your vision. Elopement and micro-wedding packages are also available, offering a perfect blend of simplicity and style. At V. Sattui Winery, weddings feel like a destination celebration in the Italian countryside—without leaving Napa Valley.

Nestled in the heart of St. Helena, our historic estate is one of the most romantic Napa Valley winery wedding venues, where ivy-covered stone walls, vineyard views, sun-drenched courtyards, and candlelit barrel rooms create a setting that feels timeless and unforgettable.

Recognized among the Top Five Winery Wedding Venues in the World, V. Sattui offers couples the beauty of wine country paired with warm hospitality, exceptional wines, and a culinary experience guided by Michelin-starred Italian chef Stefano Masanti. His menus bring the traditions of Northern Italy to Napa Valley, allowing couples to design a celebration where extraordinary food and wine are shared among family and friends.

Whether you’re planning a destination wedding in Napa Valley, working with a wedding planner or photographer, or gathering loved ones for an intimate celebration, our team is dedicated to creating a wedding experience that feels effortless, romantic, and unmistakably V. Sattui.

Wedding Celebrations at V. Sattui

Every couple celebrates differently, which is why we offer a variety of Napa Valley wedding experiences designed to accommodate different guest counts, styles, and budgets.

Couples may choose between exclusive after-hours private estate weddings, where the winery grounds become yours alone for an unforgettable evening celebration, or intimate daytime elopements and micro weddings set among the vineyards and courtyards of our historic estate.

From romantic elopements for just a few guests to larger gatherings with friends and family traveling from around the world, each wedding is centered around exceptional wine, seasonal cuisine, and the joy of sharing the moment together.

With vineyard ceremony locations, charming terraces, and the timeless atmosphere of Napa Valley wine country, V. Sattui offers a setting where unforgettable wedding memories are made.

Our Story
Company Culture
 Beaulieu Garden Connect
BEAULIEU GARDEN

Paula LeDuc Fine Catering & Events’ exclusive event property, Beaulieu Garden, is a multi-generational private estate and one of Napa Valley’s oldest premium quality wine-producing vineyards that has been the backdrop for iconic celebrations and social events for cultural icons, presidents and dignitaries, business moguls and celebrity clients. Beaulieu Garden offers the charm of a rich, historical property, that is private and immersed in nature - the idyllic setting for connection and celebration. 


Guided by our concierge event management team, clients will have all-encompassing access to Beaulieu’s remarkable site features. Guests are welcomed into the historic estate with a quarter-mile drive that is dappled with sycamore trees. From there, the team helps clients architect an effortless event in some of the most beautiful spaces this property has to offer, including the dramatic sunken garden with old stone fountains, to the arbor and vineyard with rolling hills seen for miles. 

LIMITLESS POTENTIAL, EXCLUSIVE USE

From social parties to corporate retreats, executive-level private dinners, workshops, brand events, editorial, and commercial use - Beaulieu Garden offers clients a beautiful, private space with a turn-key service team to help you utilize the space to its fullest. While Beaulieu Garden itself does not offer overnight accommodations, we have partnered with esteemed local hospitality groups and properties to guarantee a seamless lodging experience for all of our guests.

OUR CULINARY AND FLORAL GARDEN

The estate’s garden and orchard uses biodynamic planting methods dating back to the French ancestry of the property, yielding produce and fresh herbs that led to collaborations with culinary luminaries like James Beard and Julia Child. Fast forward to today, we continue to tend to the garden and source many of our seasonal ingredients from its soil. We look to the garden for inspiration and incorporate those ingredients into our menus whenever we can. Additionally, as of 2022,  our Chief Creative Officer, Kathleen Deery, started a cutting garden from which she can source flowers for projects throughout the Summer. We feel that by continuing this tradition of farming we can continue our message that the best tasting and most nutritional food is organically grown and harvested in ways that are ecologically sound.

Weddings

NAPA VALLEY ROMANCE

Luxury Napa Valley Weddings at Carneros Resort and Spa

Carneros Resort and Spa is the premier luxury wedding venue in California, located in the heart of Napa Valley. With nine indoor and outdoor event spaces accommodating celebrations from two to 300 guests, the resort hosts everything from grand destination weddings to intimate elopements in one of Northern California's most celebrated wine country settings. Whether you’re planning a grand affair or an intimate gathering, our team ensures a flawless experience from start to finish. To begin preparing, contact us at 707‑299‑4900 or info@carnerosresort.com.

START PLANNING

OPTIONS FOR ALL SIZES
Stunning Indoor & Outdoor Venues

Carneros Resort features over 35,000 square feet of flexible event space across nine distinctive venues. Outdoor favorites, such as The Arbor and Vineyard Lawn, offer breathtaking views of Napa Valley, while indoor spaces, including the Hilltop Dining Room and Napa Ballroom, bring modern elegance. From curated catering to detailed planning, each wedding is tailored to your vision. Elopement and micro-wedding packages are also available, offering a perfect blend of simplicity and style. Our experienced on-site team provides thoughtful support for every event.

WEDDING STORIES

FARM-TO-TABLE
Your Choice of Napa Cuisine

Weddings at Carneros feature menus inspired by local ingredients and seasonal flavors. From rehearsal dinners to farewell brunches, each meal is carefully tailored to your preferences and the style of your event. Our chefs offer custom tastings and work with you to craft an unforgettable culinary experience. Beverage options include handcrafted cocktails, curated wine lists, and sparkling wine toasts. Every bite is designed to elevate your celebration from start to finish.

START PLANNING

Real Napa Valley Weddings

Explore inspiring real weddings that showcase the natural beauty, thoughtful details, and timeless elegance that define a Carneros celebration.

VIEW GALLERIES

TAILORED CELEBRATIONS
Signature Venues

From expansive outdoor lawns with vineyard views to intimate indoor spaces with panoramic valley vistas, each venue provides a unique backdrop for your celebration. With nine venues to choose from, couples can create a seamless and personalized wedding experience, from ceremony to farewell brunch.

 

START PLANNING

A familial, community atmosphere is at the heart of Stanly Ranch, and every gathering captures this spirit. From bachelor parties and birthdays to family reunions and babymoons, our team takes a collaborative and personalized approach to ensure you and your guests embrace milestone gatherings full of joy. No matter the occasion, celebrations are infused with the magic and warmth of life on the ranch – and maximize the farm’s bounty.

An easy 50-minute drive from the Bay Area, Stanly Ranch is set amongst the vineyards in southern Napa Valley

Customizable amenities, creative and committed team, inspired menus

Available for resort buyouts | 135 cottages and suites, plus residences

Parties | Raise a Toast

Gathering with friends old and new is gratifying, but sharing reserve-label vintages and laughs with a side of golden hour is unparalleled. Offering one-of-a-kind venue spaces suitable for anywhere from 8 to 450 guests, Stanly Ranch holds endless possibilities for one-of-a-kind parties.

 
Holidays | Start a New Napa Tradition

Spend the holidays creating lasting memories and sharing joyful moments on the Ranch. Enjoy our seasonal wellness workshops, focused on restoration and recovery in anticipation of the new year, and indulge in an aubundance of wines and comforting dishes at Bear. Experience a slower, intimate atmosphere with friends and family in the heart of wine country this winter.

 
Reunions | Multi-Generational Memories

A pastoral idyll connecting the stories of the past with the people of the present, Stanly Ranch’s charm breathes new life into adventurers of all ages. Bond with your favorite cousins as you take a botanical cocktail class at The Grange, or grab a cabana for a fun-filled day for the whole family right beside our spectacular Lavender pool and kids’ pool.

 
VOW RENEWALS | ENDURING LOVE

Embark on the next chapter of your love story with an intimate ceremony as unique as you are. Reaffirm your lifelong commitment to one another through a vow renewal at Stanly Ranch, where our specialists are romantics at heart who delight in collaborating with each couple to create an experience that reflects an aura of tranquility and connection.

Babymoons | For Parents-to-Be

A Napa Valley Love Story with the Soul of Tuscany

At V. Sattui Winery, weddings feel like a destination celebration in the Italian countryside—without leaving Napa Valley.

Nestled in the heart of St. Helena, our historic estate is one of the most romantic Napa Valley winery wedding venues, where ivy-covered stone walls, vineyard views, sun-drenched courtyards, and candlelit barrel rooms create a setting that feels timeless and unforgettable.

Recognized among the Top Five Winery Wedding Venues in the World, V. Sattui offers couples the beauty of wine country paired with warm hospitality, exceptional wines, and a culinary experience guided by Michelin-starred Italian chef Stefano Masanti. His menus bring the traditions of Northern Italy to Napa Valley, allowing couples to design a celebration where extraordinary food and wine are shared among family and friends.

Whether you’re planning a destination wedding in Napa Valley, working with a wedding planner or photographer, or gathering loved ones for an intimate celebration, our team is dedicated to creating a wedding experience that feels effortless, romantic, and unmistakably V. Sattui.

VIEW WEDDING PACKAGES
INQUIRE ABOUT WEDDINGS
Wedding Celebrations at V. Sattui

Every couple celebrates differently, which is why we offer a variety of Napa Valley wedding experiences designed to accommodate different guest counts, styles, and budgets.

Couples may choose between exclusive after-hours private estate weddings, where the winery grounds become yours alone for an unforgettable evening celebration, or intimate daytime elopements and micro weddings set among the vineyards and courtyards of our historic estate.

From romantic elopements for just a few guests to larger gatherings with friends and family traveling from around the world, each wedding is centered around exceptional wine, seasonal cuisine, and the joy of sharing the moment together.

With vineyard ceremony locations, charming terraces, and the timeless atmosphere of Napa Valley wine country, V. Sattui offers a setting where unforgettable wedding memories are made.

Harvest Inn Weddings
AN UNFORGETTABLE, CAPTIVATING SETTING FOR YOUR MEMORIES

A vineyard-floor ceremony washed in golden Valley light, a reception on the garden terrace, dancing under the stars and twinkling lights. These are the moments you'll cherish forever when you say "I do" at Harvest Inn.

RESERVE YOUR VENUE
The Lawns
MANOR ELEGANCE AND VINEYARD-SIDE VIEWS

With 1,600 square feet alongside the vineyard and breathtaking views of the Mayacamas Mountains and rose garden, The Vin Rose Lawn is an idyllic venue for intimate wedding ceremonies of up to 120 guests.

 

The Manor House Lawn offers 2,500 square feet of meticulously manicured grass framed by botanical gardens. This dream canvas can accommodate up to 200 people.

TOUR THE VIN ROSE LAWN
TOUR THE MANOR HOUSE LAWN
The Terraces
VINEYARD ELEGANCE, AL FRESCO DINING

The iconic Vineyard View Terrace offers quintessential Napa Valley views of the vineyard and mountains, and 2,300 square feet nestled amongst the wisteria to accommodate up to 130 guests.

 

The Fountain Terrace boasts a dramatic central fountain and redwood trees, with 1,500 square feet to host up to 50 guests.

TOUR THE VINEYARD VIEW TERRACE
Indoor Venues
MARRY IN MANOR ELEGANCE

Dramatic beamed celings, oak wood floors and a large stone fireplace that spills onto a picturesque outdoor terrace, the Vineyard View Room spans 1,050 square feet and can accommodate up to 60 guests. 

Custom Catering
INCREDIBLE MENUS, TO YOUR TASTE

Our award-winning culinary team will work with you to craft a customized wedding menu, from handcrafted hors d'oeuvres to elegant plated dinners. We attend to every detail of your meal, providing all the essential elements - from tables and chairs to wine barrels and our signature wedding arbor - so you can focus on what matters most. 

Elopements
JUST MARRIED. JUST THE TWO OF YOU.

Less time spent on seating charts, more time spent with each other. An elopement at Harvest Inn is a fresh take on saying "I do" and the perfect way to make your big day intimate, joyful and personal in the heart of wine country.

 

Elopement packages start at $2,800 and include everything from the officiant to the celebratory toast:

One hour ceremony on the Vin Rose Lawn

Wedding officiant

Live music

Sparkling wine and an artisan cheese and charcuterie board to share

Our proposal packages are designed to handle the planning, timing, and finishing touches, so all you have to do is show up, take a breath, and ask the question.

Site rental with rose petal decor

Beaulieu page text snippet: Home Our Events Our Philosophy Our Story
Our Story
Company Culture
 Beaulieu Garden Connect
BEAULIEU GARDEN

Paula LeDuc Fine Catering & Events’ exclusive event property, Beaulieu Garden, is a multi-generational private estate and one of Napa Valley’s oldest premium quality wine-producing vineyards that has been the backdrop for iconic celebrations and social events for cultural icons, presidents and dignitaries, business moguls and celebrity clients. Beaulieu Garden offers the charm of a rich, historical property, that is private and immersed in nature - the idyllic setting for connection and celebration. 


Guided by our concierge event management team, clients will have all-encompassing access to Beaulieu’s remarkable site features. Guests are welcomed into the historic estate with a quarter-mile drive that is dappled with sycamore trees. From there, the team helps clients architect an effortless event in some of the most beautiful spaces this property has to offer, including the dramatic sunken garden with old stone fountains, to the arbor and vineyard with rolling hills seen for miles. 

LIMITLESS POTENTIAL, EXCLUSIVE USE

From social parties to corporate retreats, executive-level private dinners, workshops, brand events, editorial, and commercial use - Beaulieu Garden offers clients a beautiful, private space with a turn-key service team to help you utilize the space to its fullest. While Beaulieu Garden itself does not offer overnight accommodations, we have partnered with esteemed local hospitality groups and properties to guarantee a seamless lodging experience for all of our guests.

OUR CULINARY AND FLORAL GARDEN

The estate’s garden and orchard uses biodynamic planting methods dating back to the French ancestry of the property, yielding produce and fresh herbs that led to collaborations with culinary luminaries like James Beard and Julia Child. Fast forward to today, we continue to tend to the garden and source many of our seasonal ingredients from its soil. We look to the garden for inspiration and incorporate those ingredients into our menus whenever we can. Additionally, as of 2022,  our Chief Creative Officer, Kathleen Deery, started a cutting garden from which she can source flowers for projects throughout the Summer. We feel that by continuing this tradition of farming we can continue our message that the best tasting and most nutritional food is organically grown and harvested in ways that are ecologically sound.

args.code:
const tabId = 787783896;

const rows = [
  ["Venue Name", "Location", "Maximum Guest Capacity", "Venue Description", "Link to Venue Page"],
  [
    "Carneros Resort and Spa",
    "Napa (4048 Sonoma Hwy, Napa, CA 94559)",
    "300 guests (Vineyard Lawn: 300, The Arbor: 250; up to 300 across 9 indoor/outdoor venues)",
    "Premier luxury wine country resort in Napa Valley with private cottages, picturesque vineyard lawns, trellis arbor, modern indoor ballrooms, and panoramic rolling hill views.",
    "https://www.carnerosresort.com/luxury-napa-weddings/"
  ],
  [
    "The Meritage Resort and Spa",
    "Napa (875 Bordeaux Way, Napa, CA 94558)",
    "1,000 guests (Village Lawn: 1,000, Meritage Ballroom: 650, Carneros Ballroom: 500, Vineyard Hilltop: 400, Vineyard Deck: 350, Estate Cave: 200)",
    "Expansive 36-acre wine country resort featuring an underground candlelit Estate Cave with wrought-iron chandeliers, hillside vineyards, scenic lawn terraces, Tuscan gazebo, and grand ballrooms.",
    "https://www.meritageresort.com/gather/venues/napa-wedding-venues/"
  ],
  [
    "Silverado Resort",
    "Napa (1600 Atlas Peak Road, Napa, CA 94558)",
    "500 guests (Mansion Gardens: up to 500 guests, Fairway Deck: up to 320 guests, Silverado Ballroom: up to 320 guests, The Grove: up to 250 guests)",
    "Landmark Napa Valley golf and spa resort surrounded by rolling fairways, historic mansion gardens, garden pavilion, ballroom with crystal chandeliers, and vineyard views.",
    "https://www.silveradoresort.com/gather/weddings/weddings-venues/"
  ],
  [
    "Stanly Ranch, Auberge Resorts Collection",
    "Napa (200 Stanly Crossroad, Napa, CA 94559)",
    "450 guests (Accommodates up to 450 guests; Glasshouse Barn: 450 reception / 300 rounds, Glasshouse Terrace: 300 reception / 280 rounds, Cutting Garden: 300 reception / 200 rounds)",
    "Historic working ranch turned luxury Auberge resort set among vineyards in southern Napa Valley with modern barn architecture, botanical gardens, and lavender lawns.",
    "https://auberge.com/stanly-ranch/events/weddings/"
  ],
  [
    "Charles Krug Winery",
    "St. Helena (2800 Main Street, St. Helena, CA 94574)",
    "1,200 guests (Great Lawn: 1,200 reception / 800 seated, Carriage House Upstairs: 500 reception / 300 seated, Redwood Cellar: 250 reception / 110 seated)",
    "Legendary historic winery estate founded in 1861 (one of only five Napa wineries legally permitted to host weddings), featuring heritage oak trees, vineyard surroundings, and an 1881 historic Carriage House with cathedral ceilings.",
    "https://charleskrug.com/visit/wedding-celebrations"
  ],
  [
    "V. Sattui Winery",
    "St. Helena (1111 White Lane @ Hwy 29, St. Helena, CA 94574)",
    "250 guests (Accommodates groups up to 250 guests; welcomes celebrations from 35 to 250 guests)",
    "Romantic historic St. Helena winery with Tuscan rustic charm, ivy-covered stone buildings, vineyard terraces, candlelit barrel rooms, and Michelin-starred culinary offerings.",
    "https://www.vsattui.com/experiences/wedding-events/"
  ],
  [
    "Harvest Inn",
    "St. Helena (1 Main Street, St. Helena, CA 94574)",
    "200 guests (The Manor House Lawn accommodates up to 200 people; Vin Rose Lawn: up to 120 guests; Vineyard View Terrace: up to 130 guests)",
    "Charming resort nestled into St. Helena vineyards with brick cottages, botanical gardens, redwood trees, Mayacamas mountain views, and manicured event lawns.",
    "https://www.harvestinn.com/weddings/"
  ],
  [
    "The Estate Yountville",
    "Yountville (6481 Washington Street, Yountville, CA 94599)",
    "420 guests (The Pavilion: 420 guests, The Grove: 300 guests, The Social: 276 guests, The Barrel Room: 180 guests)",
    "Expansive 22-acre village estate in downtown Yountville featuring two luxury hotels, classic terraced gardens, gazebo pavilions, and a historic exposed-brick barrel room.",
    "https://www.theestateyountville.com/weddings-events/event-spaces/"
  ],
  [
    "Solage, Auberge Resorts Collection",
    "Calistoga (755 Silverado Trail N, Calistoga, CA 94515)",
    "260 guests (Solstice Event Lawn: 260-person capacity; Solstice Ballroom: 210 rounds / 230 reception)",
    "Contemporary wine country resort in Calistoga framed by the Palisades Mountains, featuring modern farmhouse-style ballroom with vaulted ceilings, outdoor terraces, and the Solstice Event Lawn.",
    "https://auberge.com/solage/events/weddings/"
  ],
  [
    "Farmstead at Long Meadow Ranch",
    "St. Helena (738 Main Street, St. Helena, CA 94574)",
    "250 guests (Grand celebrations for up to 250 guests; Lawn accommodates up to 300 guests)",
    "Refined agricultural estate and winery in St. Helena offering farm-to-table cuisine, organic vineyard setting, rustic modern barn, open event lawn with fire pit, and walnut tree ceremony sites.",
    "https://www.longmeadowranch.com/weddings-functions/weddings-events/"
  ]
];

const tsv = rows.map(r => r.join("\t")).join("\n");

// Write to clipboard in page context
await browserjs(tabId, async (tsvData) => {
  await navigator.clipboard.writeText(tsvData);
}, tsv);

// Now paste into the active cell (A1)
await tool.press({ tabId, keys: "ControlOrMeta+v" });
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000));

const shot = await browser.screenshot({ tabId });
console.log("Screenshot after paste:", shot.image);

### Part 4: Napa Valley vs. Gangnam-gu Venue Comparison Report

| Feature / Dimension | Napa Valley Venue Pool | Gangnam-gu, Seoul Venue Pool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Typical Capacity & Scale** | Most venues center on **200 to 450 guests** (with select estates like Charles Krug or Meritage scaling higher on open lawns). | Most venues center on **300 to 1,000 guests**, designed for high-density ceremonies and large sequential banquet dining. |
| **Primary Venue Types** | Historic wineries, private ranches, luxury spa/golf resorts, and garden estates. | Specialized multi-floor wedding halls, European castle/house venues (The Raum, Noble Valence), convention centers (Coex, Sono Felice), and 5-star international hotels (InterContinental, Imperial Palace). |
| **Atmosphere & Scenery** | Natural outdoor orientation: rolling vineyard hills, Mayacamas mountain vistas, ancient oak trees, outdoor fire pits, and wine caves. | Urban architectural grandeur: high ceilings (8–10m), multi-tiered crystal chandeliers, theatrical lighting, LED media walls, and floral aisle runways. |
| **Event Structure & Flow** | Often multi-day destination weekends (welcome reception, ceremony, dinner, late-night dancing, farewell brunch) with lodging on-site. | Structured single-day celebrations with defined time slots (typically 90 to 120 minutes per ceremony block), followed by immediate banquet or buffet dining. |
| **Weather Dependability** | High reliance on favorable fall weather for outdoor lawns and terraces (with indoor ballrooms or pavilions as contingency plans). | Fully climate-controlled indoor environments protected from seasonal weather fluctuations, with occasional rooftop or garden spaces (The Raum). |
| **Logistics & Accessibility** | Rural valley roads (Hwy 29, Silverado Trail); guests typically require chartered shuttles, private vehicles, or weekend hotel blocks. | Dense urban center with direct subway access (Subway Lines 2, 7, 9, Suin-Bundang Line), extensive basement parking structures, and city airport terminal integration. |
